command: $ports=@(5173,8080,18080,3306,16379);$rows=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.LocalPort -in $ports} | ForEach-Object {$p=Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; [pscustomobject]@{address=$_.LocalAddress;port=$_.LocalPort;pid=$_.OwningProcess;process=$p.ProcessName}}); ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $rows -Compress
